itinerary: Day 1: Arrive Islamabad, hotel check-in
Day 2: Flight to Gilgit with mountain views
Day 3: Drive to Tarashing, Astore Valley; Nanga Parbat viewpoint
Day 4: Trek Tarashing to Herrligkoffer Base Camp (3550m)
Day 5: Cross Bazhin Glacier to Latobah
Day 6: Trek to Shigiari, superb south face views
Day 7: Trek to Mazeno base camp, return Latobah
Day 8: Return trek to Tarashing
Day 9: Drive to Naran via Babusar Pass
Day 10: Drive to Islamabad, city tour, farewell dinner
pros: Classic Tarashing/Astore approach to Herrligkoffer BC at 3550m
Optional push to Mazeno Pass (5400m) beyond base camp
Wide inclusions: domestic flights, jeeps, porters, cook, entrance fees
Route guide map and bottled mineral water provided
Strong south-face viewpoints (Shigiari) built into the route
cons: Rupal-only; does not include the north (Fairy Meadows) face
Hotel meals, drinks and personal expenses excluded
No CKNP/national park fee detail stated on the page
verdict: A well-rounded 10-day Rupal-face itinerary with a flight in, full crew, and an optional Mazeno Pass extension. Good value if you only want the south face and don't mind hotel meals being extra.
excludes: Hotel meals, drinks, personal expenses, guide/driver tips, early check-in/late checkout, airline delays, international flights and visa fees.

itinerary: Day 1: Arrive Islamabad/Rawalpindi, city tour
Day 2: Drive to Chilas (279km via Naran)
Day 3: Trek to Fairy Meadows (3306m), Nanga Parbat views
Day 4: Excursion to Nanga Parbat (Raikot) base camp (3967m)
Day 5: Full-day excursion to Jiliper Peak BC
Day 6: Trek down to Tarashing village (2911m)
Day 7: Trek Tarashing to Herrligkoffer BC (3550m)
Day 8: Trek to Shaigiri (3655m)
Day 9: Excursion to Rupal base camp
Day 10: Trek back to Tarashing
Day 11: Drive to Chilas
Day 12: Drive to Islamabad
Day 13: Departure
pros: Covers BOTH north (Fairy Meadows/Raikot) and south (Rupal) faces
All meals (breakfast, lunch, dinner) included throughout
All hotel accommodation and road/domestic transfers included
Licensed professional guide plus 15kg personal-luggage porter
cons: Sleeping bag not provided; bring your own
Tips for drivers, porters and staff excluded
Single-supplement / some non-package meals not covered
No Mazeno Pass option and no CKNP fee detail on the page
verdict: The most comprehensive option, pairing Fairy Meadows with the Rupal valley in one 13-day trip with full board and a sat phone. Best for travellers who want both faces of Nanga Parbat rather than Rupal alone.
excludes: International airfare, visa fee, sleeping bag, tips for drivers/porters/staff, and personal expenses; single supplements and some non-package meals not included.

itinerary: Day 1-2: Arrive Islamabad, city sightseeing
Day 3: Drive Islamabad to Chilas (1265m)
Day 4: Drive Chilas to Tarashing village (2900m)
Day 5: Trek Tarashing to Herrligkoffer BC (~3530m)
Day 6: Trek to Latobah base camp (3650m)
Day 7: Return trek to Tarashing
Day 8-9: Drive back to Islamabad
Day 10: Airport transfer, Taxila museum visit
pros: Base-camp staff, meals, tents and camping equipment included
Satellite phone and group/staff medical first-aid kit provided
Hotel accommodation in Islamabad, Chilas and Tarashing included
cons: Shortest trek: only Herrligkoffer and Latobah, no Mazeno Pass
Sleeping bags, personal climbing gear and insurance excluded
Recommends a $5000 helicopter-rescue deposit; no CKNP fee detail
verdict: A no-frills, all-road 10-day Rupal trek that gets to base camp efficiently but skips Mazeno and the longer side excursions. Suits trekkers wanting a shorter, simpler south-face trip.
excludes: International flights, personal climbing gear, sleeping bags, personal insurance, oxygen equipment, and customs clearing charges; $5000 helicopter-rescue deposit recommended.

itinerary: Day 1: Arrive Islamabad, city tour
Day 2: Flight to Gilgit
Day 3: Drive to Tarashing, Astore Valley
Day 4: Tarashing to Herrligkoffer Base Camp (3550m)
Day 5: Herrligkoffer BC to Latobah
Day 6: Latobah to Shigiari
Day 7: Latobah to Mazeno Base Camp day trip
Day 8: Latobah back to Tarashing
Day 9: Tarashing to Naran Valley
Day 10: Naran to Islamabad, city tour, departure
pros: CKNP fee (US $150/member) and $200 environmental fund included
Tarashing (2900m) jeep approach to Herrligkoffer BC at 3550m
Mazeno Glacier terminus side trip included on Day 7
Domestic flights, jeep transport and full-board camp food included
Liaison-officer insurance and permit assistance provided
cons: Rupal-only; explicitly contrasted with Fairy Meadows (Raikot) face
Sleeping bags and personal gear not provided
Member insurance/liability excluded; $15,000 helicopter rescue on you
verdict: A transparent 10-day Rupal trek that bundles the CKNP and environmental fees most rivals leave out, plus a Mazeno glacier side trip. Strong pick if you want fewer surprise charges on the south face.
excludes: Sleeping bags/personal gear, helicopter rescue ($15,000), hotel meals/beverages in cities, member insurance/liability, tips, and extra baggage fees.
